description: Build COSE_Sign1-shaped statements for a range of audit entries and submit them to the configured SCITT transparency service. Where none is configured the statements are returned for submission out of band.

issuer.description: Issuer identifier placed on each SCITT signed statement, naming who vouches for the chain. Defaults to 'service:coordinator'. Where no submitter is configured the statements are returned unsigned for the deployment to submit out of band.

range.description: Sequence window to anchor. Omit to submit the whole chain.
